ai_summary: This document contains corporate announcements from Advani Hotels & Resorts and Asit C Mehta Financial Services, primarily regarding upcoming virtual Annual General Meetings. A key financial takeaway is an equity offering (likely from Advani Hotels) that garnered significant institutional interest with up to 139x oversubscription, contrasting with modest retail participation at 1.11x. Additionally, a material regulatory impact for ASIT C Mehta shareholders is a February 2027 deadline for physical share dematerialization, incurring a one-year lock-in period on those transferred securities.
